evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: We talk to a lot of customers everyday and some of their concerns are movers not arriving on time or damages to their Adams or any of these or concerns as well.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer says timing is most important and wants to leave early. Rep responds: 'Okay' and 'I see. I understand sir. You're driving the truck.' No follow-up ask for more detail or silence held.
evidence_quotes.value_days: No mention of Value Days, day-of-week pricing, or date flexibility at any point.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep never mentions rate lock, deposits, or asks for the business. Call ends with 'I'll send it to your email shortly' and no explicit ask for booking.

top_strength: Joanna successfully gathered the customer's name and used it, established a two-concerns opener early, and disclosed pricing structure with transparency (hourly rate, all-inclusive fees, $2,000 damage coverage, 2.5-hour minimum in 15-minute increments).
coaching_note: After the customer named timing as a concern, Joanna acknowledged but did not dig deeper with follow-up questions—she moved to logistics instead of going two layers deep on what 'timing' meant to him; and critically, she never asked for the business or mentioned rate lock, leaving the call unasked-for and the customer unbooked despite having a quote.
